correctness.rationale: C: Adjunction and Mordell--Weil order four exclude every unlisted negative curve. Shioda height pairing yields each section attachment and vanishing pairwise section intersections. The explicit symmetric integer intersection matrix is completely specified. Packaged pure-Python verifier uses Fraction arithmetic for all 16,384 principal subsets, identifies 24 minimal failed sets, checks the avoidance equivalence for every subset, and independently recomputes all polynomial coefficients via exact inclusion-exclusion on forbidden sets. Both calculations give 6656, maximum support size 9, count 102. No finite sampling or numerical approximations are used.

value.rationale: V: The unique order-four semistable extremal rational elliptic surface is a natural classification entry with the genuinely different double-edge I2 component intersection and four torsion sections. Its 24 minimal forbidden curve supports give a complete description of allowed stable-base-locus supports and detect new three-curve obstructions involving two sections meeting the same I2 component; the full chamber polynomial is a natural birational-geometric invariant rather than an arbitrary sample. The enumerative result is exact and not logically implied by the named tables without the finite classification. It has independent value as a complete model-specific classification, despite not being a new general counting theorem.
